title: fagara melanacantha
intro: Fagara melanacantha, commonly known as the yellow prickly ash, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with its reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fagara melanacantha are attributed to its ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and treat gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
